rule: A search carrying afterWrite succeeds only after every required representation of the new record is visible to that exact query.
adversarialIntent: Let canonical, lexical, and embedding visibility become ready in different orders so any single-watermark shortcut produces a false success.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: Success occurs only after all required states are ready and visible to the query under its scope.
If the deadline arrives first, the outcome is a structured timeout result.
A pending, failed, superseded, wrong-spec, or globally-ready-but-query-invisible state never produces success.
The new record cannot appear before its required state is satisfied.
